name: Passage to Booty Bay
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ah yes, finally found it. Should have told me she passed through here that long ago. Let's see.

Velinde. Booked passage to Booty Bay on the Black Osprey. I don't have anything here saying otherwise, so I'd assume it arrived in port safely.

Not much more help I can be to you, but she asked about overland travel over on that side of the world, and I mentioned Ruzzgot, a caravan driver based out of Booty Bay. Might be that this Velinde traveled with him.

Move along, now. I haven't all day for you.
narrative.objectives: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes? Now, it doesn't look to me like you're the sort with goods that need shipping, so either you're looking for a job with my caravan--and there's no jobs to be had now--or you're probably talking to the wrong goblin.

So which one is it?

chain.subtitle: 9 quests at level 30, 12,400 XP in all.

quests.name: The Howling Vale
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.

quests.name: Velinde Starsong
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

quests.name: Velinde's Effects
quests.objectiveText: Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Barrens Port
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

quests.name: Passage to Booty Bay
quests.objectiveText: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.

quests.name: The Caravan Road
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Clerk Daltry in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Carevin Family
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Scythe of Elune
quests.objectiveText: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: Answered Questions
quests.objectiveText: Return to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.
